page.overview:
Who is Starduster?

Starduster is a G.I. Joe character from the A Real American Hero series.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Starduster was first available as a mail-in exclusive from G.I. Joe Action Stars Cereal in 1987. In 1988, he was available as a mail-in offer from Hasbro Direct. After three years and several variants, he was discontinued in 1991. ---- Appearance: black hair; short-sleeved, open-collared light blue shirt with beige strap or holster; grey gloves and boots; light blue pants with green camouflage; black belt and boots

Accessories: light blue "Breaker" helmet with star on front; black visor (a repaint of the 1982 clear visors); green J.U.M.P. jet pack; silver "Gung-Ho" grenade launcher.
